question: Which institute set the new Asia Book of Records in 2025 for the largest healthcare yoga session?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**AIIMS Mohali**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• AIIMS Mohali Sets Asia Record for Largest Yoga Session by Healthcare Professionals on Yoga Day.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Dr. B.R. Ambedkar State Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS Mohali)** set a **new Asia Book of Records title** on **International Day of Yoga (IDY) 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
**3,003 healthcare professionals** participated — including **doctors, MBBS students, nurses, and paramedics**.

 
 
• 
 
The record was for the **largest yoga session by healthcare professionals**.

 
 
• 
 
The previous record was held by **PGI, Chandigarh,** with **1,924 participants** (last year).

 
 
• 
 
The celebration was observed **enthusiastically across Punjab**.

 
 
• 
 
The **Border Security Force (BSF)** celebrated IYD at the **Attari Joint Check Post**, involving **border village residents** of **Amritsar**.

 
 
• 
 
The theme was **“Ek Prithvee, Ek Swaasthya Ke Liye Yog”** (One Earth, One Health through Yoga).
